title: Update availability when item is added
gherkin:
Feature: Real-time availability update
  Scenario: Item is added to inventory
    Given the inventory is empty
    When an item is added to the inventory
    Then the availability should be updated to reflect the new item
rationale: To ensure that the system updates availability in real-time when an item is added to the inventory.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the requirement of real-time availability updates in a system.
